---
title: "Kdenlive"
---

Install Kdenlive for video editing and FFmpeg for media processing. The role enables
[RPM Fusion](https://rpmfusion.org/) and installs its `ffmpeg` package, which provides
the full FFmpeg build and additional codec support.

```sh
ansible-playbook -i inventory -K playbooks/lab-stack.yml --tags video_editing
```

## Check

::: {.callout-check}
**✅ Check**

```sh
ffmpeg -version
kdenlive --version
```
:::
